description: Impacts of Metro Network Configuration on On-Road Traffic Intensity in Chinese Cities (Dataset) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yifu Ou. This dataset is constructed to analyze the impacts of China's metro network development on vehicle use. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 27968 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
